# LLM Wiki Overview

The note argues for a [[Persistent Wiki]] that sits between the human and the raw material. It depends on [[Raw Sources]], a maintained [[Index and Log]], and a browsing surface like [[Obsidian]].

## Why it matters

- The wiki compounds instead of forcing the model to rediscover everything from raw files.
- Every ingest should update the surrounding pages instead of producing one isolated summary.
- The result is an evolving knowledge base that feels closer to software maintenance than chat history.
